name: Ralkoz
detailed_description:
Game Description

Are you ready?
This is not just another night. Tonight, you will confront your past — a night where fate puts you through one final test.

On the longest night of the year, a man named Max embarks on a mysterious expedition to a place called Ralkoz — a dark region wiped from maps and hidden by the government. The promised reward: one million dollars.
But this mission is not just about the money. For Max, it is a journey of reckoning and transformation.
After losing his wife and son in a tragic accident and then his daughter to a brain hemorrhage, Max has nothing left to live for. All he has is a mission, a place, and secrets buried in the dark.

Game Features:

  • Single-player, cinematic story-driven experience

  • First-person shooter gameplay

  • 8 distinct weapons (6 firearms, 1 melee weapon, 1 grenade)

  • Encounter enemies with unique traits and abilities

  • Use an advanced AI-powered scanner to gather environmental data and uncover hidden histories

  • Deep psychological narrative with emotional impact

  • The main goal: to uncover the secrets of Ralkoz and reshape the fates of those who came before

  • Approximately 4 hours of gameplay

  • A blend of exploration, horror, action, and drama

  • Immersive atmosphere set in a mysterious, forested region

  • Developed using the Unity engine

Max was an ordinary man. After losing his family in a tragic accident, he took security jobs in bars to support his daughter and learned how to handle weapons. Later, he survived through hunting. When offered a government-funded exploration mission by a geologist named Alice, he initially refused. But after the death of his daughter, he had nothing left to lose.
Without realizing it, he was being drawn into Ralkoz. This journey would not only change his destiny but also the destinies of those who had come to Ralkoz before him.
In the end, he would discover the deepest secret of Ralkoz — and the one thing that should never be done.
